name: MapLegend
label: Map legend
description: The corner block of a map: its name, what it shows, and the key to its markers.

props.name: title
props.description:
The map's name, set above the key. Intentionally shadows the native
`title` tooltip attribute, which MapLegend does not expose.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two lines saying what the map shows.

props.name: items
props.description: The key itself: one row per marker kind.
